articles.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Unveils First AI Native Wi Fi 8 Gateway For Home Broadband
articles.description: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) and broadband partners announced the world's first AI native Wi Fi 8 gateway for home networks. The new gateway is built on Qualcomm's latest platform that combines next generation Wi Fi 8 connectivity with on device edge AI compute. The product targets residential broadband providers looking to add agentic AI services directly in the home rather than relying only on cloud compute. articles.title: ByteDance in Talks to Secure MediaTek AI Chips for Data Centers
articles.description: ByteDance Ltd. is close to an agreement to buy MediaTek Inc. data center semiconductors, a deal that would secure vital components for TikTok’s owner while helping the Taiwanese chipmaker compete with Qualcomm Inc.
